resultContext: DataChangeResult.context is the recorded observed post-context. Successful actions may advance branch/head; dbId/authorityId/restoreEpoch/crew/namespace remain the request authority. beforeHead is the submitted head; afterHead equals successful context.head.

Pending/Unknown without a proved publication retains original submitted coordinates. UUID facts inside Dolt never embed their own future commit hash; the real hash is obtained from protected UUID fact plus unique version publication witness and stored in Core result.

Clients persist original request context for pure lookup. Lookup returns the immutable old recorded result; current workspace is returned separately. Advancing current HEAD or deleting old branch does not block lookup or rewrite a historical result.
Next independent explicit write uses observed successful post-context or a fresh workspace.get; unknown/notFound never authorizes replay or a replacement UUID.

capability.name: data
capability.condition: Only when Core16 control-plane/authority/paired restore qualification and exact sibling worker IPC1/runtime are ready. Missing/unqualified worker/authority suppresses advertisement; document.* on Core16 fails closed rather than use old SQLite documents.
capability.scope: Capability is implementation availability, not per-crew ACL or data health. workspace.get reports uninitialized/unavailable namespace; each operation rechecks current ACL/epoch.
capability.readonly: workspace.get and request.get never initialize or write.
capability.firstWrite: Initialize or explicit first Apply with expectedHead=None gets a durable UUID/control capsule and stable namespace/IDs before worker initialize. A lost reply or half-initialization is Unknown; lookup never repeats or creates. An existing file is verified/recovered read-only under the original UUID, never silently overwritten.

renderer: Scoped standing knowledge-write only permits ordinary Apply under declared host grant. Initialize/branch/merge/restore/ResolveUnknown or grant changes require a real native host Human action/one-shot confirmation and Core actual permission; acknowledge:true from JS or synthetic click is not authorization.
